name: persist-reason-steps
goal: history reasons keeps what explain check accepts: the reasons of every fully explained step of a range, each judged by its own revision's writing limits

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: explain check accepts a range explained step by step; history reasons matched only the range as a whole, so it kept nothing and called the unit stale. Expected: persistence asks the same range question, keeps every step reason unchanged, and still keeps nothing for an unexplained step

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: bunx vitest run test/history-reason-steps.e2e.test.ts on persistReasons ace8dd7286aa: 2 failed (exit 1, attached 0, missing stale while explain check passes), guard passed. /tmp/harness-persist-chain-red.log; final test file 38e52c3f9ca3 against HEAD in a temporary export: same, /tmp/harness-persist-chain-red-final.log

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: persistReasons calls explainedRange for its range instead of the direct ExplanationService match; nothing else changed in source. New test wired into test:e2e; manifest of workflow.persist-reasons re-indexed

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same test file: 3 passed (/tmp/harness-persist-chain-green.log). Existing history-reasons, explain, explain-steps, explain-brevity, explain-versions: 16 passed (/tmp/harness-persist-chain-guard.log). tsc, eslint, prettier, audit and units check clean. Full repository suite not run

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
